title: Home Safety and Accident Prevention
summary: A toddler is curious and quick, and household accidents are a leading cause of injuries at this age. Secure your home: keep cleaning products and medications out of reach, stabilize furniture that could topple, protect sockets and stairs, and never leave your child near water alone. Prevention is cheaper and safer than treatment.
try_this: This week: Walk through your home at your child’s eye level and fix three hazards you spot (cleaning products, sockets, furniture).
reflection_prompts: Which area in your home is the most dangerous for your child?
What have you secured this week?
